text:
maria: Quick proposal — instead of immediate v1 banner we add a short-term opt-in header so clients can opt into 'v1-compat' behavior while we show console projections.

alex: I like that. So header takes precedence for routing? i.e., if header present route to v1 even if tenant pinned to v2?

maria: yes. priority: explicit header > tenant pin > console override. That keeps control and avoids accidental silent switches.

sai: telemetry note: please tag requests with `compat_header=true` and `client_reported_version` if present. Also add a seq_len histogram split by routed_version.

jordan: console should show a "migration impact" card: projected token delta, projected spend, and % of requests using the compat header. Can we reuse Optimize's cost model for projections?

maria: yep — reuse Optimize. Show 30/60/90d projections and an anchor to current committed usage.

megan: banner UX question — if a tenant opts in via header do they still see the deprecation banner in the console?

alex: No. opted-in tenants get a subtle badge + telemetry link. Non-opted tenants keep the full deprecation banner with the migration guide.

console-bot: rollout-bot: rolling deprec-banner v1 -> canary cohort (5% tenants) :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-22T14:12Z — compat-header routing toggle enabled for canary cohort.

sre-ops: added alert: page if >5% v1 traffic from tenants without compat header for >10m. Also watching routing latency regressions.

maria: can someone stub the docs snippet + example curl? I want a one-liner we can paste in the banner.

jordan: I'll open PR for console card and the backend flags. ETA EOD Friday.

megan: I'll draft banner copy + FAQ. Quick copy: "/v1 will be deprecated on YYYY-MM-DD. To keep behavior, set header `X-Redwood-Compat: v1=1` or follow our migration guide: <link>".

alex: small config note — header parsing should be strict: only accept `v1=1` or `v2=1`; ignore unknown keys and log a telemetry event for invalid formats.

sai: agreed. log invalid header formats to compat.header.invalid_count and sample the header value for debugging (PII-safe).

maria: nice. next steps: (1) backend header routing impl + tests, (2) telemetry tags and alerts, (3) console card + cost projections, (4) banner + docs. I'll compile the checklist tomorrow.

maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
